name: Houses of the Holy
summary: Leonid Barthalomew asks you to recover holy water from Stratholme for the Argent Dawn. He sees his undeath as both an illness and a blessing against the Scourge.

sections.title: Water for the Dawn
sections.body: Leonid Barthalomew, revered among his colleagues, asks for your help in Stratholme. He regards his undeath as a malady that needs treatment, yet also as a blessing the Argent Dawn can use against the Scourge. Search the city's supply crates for the holy water the order has in surplus, then bring it back to Leonid.

faq.answer: Leonid Barthalomew, whom his colleagues revere for his sacrifices, asks for help recovering holy water for the Argent Dawn.

faq.q: Why does Leonid want the holy water?
faq.answer: The holy water is the Argent Dawn's own surplus, left in supply crates in Stratholme, and Leonid wants it back for the Dawn's fight against the Scourge.
The holy water is in supply crates scattered through Stratholme.

faq.q: What does Leonid think of his undeath?
faq.answer: Leonid regards his undeath as an illness that needs treatment, but also as a blessing for the Argent Dawn in its fight against the Scourge.

faq.q: Who does Leonid want to fight?
faq.answer: Leonid says the holy water can aid the Argent Dawn against the Scourge, the minions of Kel'Thuzad.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can assist Leonid Barthalomew and the Argent Dawn by recovering their holy water from Stratholme.
As a member of the Horde, you can assist Leonid Barthalomew and the Argent Dawn by recovering their holy water from Stratholme.
As an undead traveler, you may understand Leonid's view of undeath as both a malady and a blessing.
